headline: Record Russian KAB Attacks Intensify as Israel Rejects US Gaza Proposal
subheadline: The USS Boxer redirected 45 commercial vessels during enforcement while the Houthi movement claimed to target a sensitive Saudi Arabian airport.
lede: Russia utilized over 8,300 guided aerial bombs in July, marking the highest monthly figure of the war while striking civilian infrastructure in Sumy and Mykolaiv. Israel rejected a US draft proposal regarding Gaza, maintaining its operational stance in the territory as diplomatic efforts regarding the Strait of Hormuz intensify. The US Navy's USS Boxer supported a blockade against Iran, having redirected 45 commercial vessels as of August 4. The IDF destroyed ten workshops used for manufacturing explosives in the Kabatia area of the Menashe Brigade.

sections.title: Russia Sets Record Aerial Bombardment Pace
sections.body: Russian forces utilized over 8,300 guided aerial bombs during July, the highest monthly figure of the conflict. In Sumy Oblast, six KABs killed two children and a 75-year-old woman, while a strike in Mykolaiv killed an 89-year-old woman and injured seven others. Ukrainian drones destroyed a Russian Wildberries logistics hub in the Tula region, causing a fire covering approximately 300,000 square meters.

sections.title: Houthi Strikes and Israeli Diplomatic Rejection
sections.body: The Houthi movement claimed to have attacked a sensitive target at a Saudi Arabian airport. A Houthi-linked vessel, MSV Fayz Noor Alia, was sunk in the Red Sea near Yemen, though all 14 crew members were rescued. Israel's Prime Minister stated the government has not agreed to a US draft proposal regarding Gaza. US officials reported progress in talks regarding the Strait of Hormuz, with hopes for a resolution soon.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The operational environment is characterized by high volatility due to Houthi maritime strikes and US naval enforcement in regional waters. The rejection of US-led Gaza proposals by Israel suggests continued friction in diplomatic efforts, while the record use of KABs by Russian forces indicates a sustained focus on aerial bombardment and civilian targeting.
